answer: Problem: clone farms mint many wallets to harvest challenge tips. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 12-unit orchard bond locked 48h and must complete one peer task scored >=2 by two haven graders who each hold >=5 prior truthful seals. Cost: bond idle capital plus about 25 minutes of real work. Verification: bond txid and grade-sealed rows cross-check a public quartz registry of burned invite trees. Failure: a score-0 grade burns 55% of the bond and freezes the sponsor invite lane for one epoch.
